name: Prop State Tracking
purpose: Track possession, hand, position, damage, fill level and visibility of story-relevant objects.
scope: Bounded continuity_state capability; must operate on versioned structured artifacts.
out_of_scope: final approval outside owner decision rights
procedure: Validate authoritative inputs specifically required for prop_state_tracking.
Execute the bounded operation: Track possession, hand, position, damage, fill level and visibility of story-relevant objects.
Apply prop_state_tracking-specific decision rules and record evidence/uncertainty.
Validate the named output against its workflow contract and creative invariants.
Record provenance and hand off to director, qc_supervisor.
decision_rules: do not invent missing upstream decisions
prefer local repair over global rewrite when scope is local
escalate when confidence is low and impact is high
creative_invariants: preserve approved premise/theme/character/world/visual invariants unless work order explicitly authorizes change
examples: Run prop_state_tracking on fixture/project artifact and emit a scored result.
counterexamples: Do not ask prop_state_tracking to "make the whole film better" or override another department.
